idea: How to prevent bad smells from drains
title: Why Your Drain Smells and How to Fix It
description: Bad drain odors in the home are usually caused by a dried-out P-trap or accumulated organic debris inside the pipes. The curved P-trap beneath your sink holds a standing water seal that blocks sewer gases from rising into your living space. If a fixture isn't used regularly, this water seal evaporates. Run water down seldom-used sinks for 30 seconds weekly to keep the trap seal intact. For active drains, flush buildup using baking soda followed by warm vinegar. Avoid harsh chemical cleaners that can corrode your piping. If foul smells persist, consult a licensed plumber to inspect your drain vent stack.
